name: Maria Morevna
subtitle: Warrior Princess
description: Strike through defences and protection buffs and deal significant damage to your foes
lore: A warrior queen of Vyraj, Maria fights in defense of the realm and her personal domain, but she is greatly displeased with this new world. The love of her old life has not reappeared since the Shattering, her exploits are largely forgotten, and her greatest enemy—Koshchei—has returned stronger than ever. In response, her methods and temper grow ever more violent.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity whenever an enemy gains a buff. Gain an additional [100] Divinity if it is an [Immortal] buff.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%
Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%

skills.name: Mage Hunter
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy. Place an [Extra Hit] if the target has 3 or more buffs.

skills.name: Resolute Assault
skills.description: Increases damage inflicted by +3% for each [Buff] on the target.

skills.name: Battle Queen
skills.description: Attack all enemies and ignore [mechanic:shield] and [mechanic:barrier] on each target.

skills.name: Breach the Defences
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy. Reduces the DEF of the target by 2% (Stacking up to 5 times).

imprint_passive: Increases damage inflicted by +1.5% for each [Buff] on the target.
